text:
maria: Heads-up — Product wants to change Pro tier rate limits in EU next month. They ran a pricing experiment and sims show a short-lived spike in both requests and token usage. Can infra run a quick capacity & warmup plan?

tyler: On it. Do we have the uplift numbers from the sim?

kunal: Sharing the sim that PM sent. Numbers are conservative but worth planning for.

maria: Paste from PM: 
```
SIMULATION SUMMARY:
baseline qps (eu): 1,200
expected qps_post_change: 1,520 (+27%)
median tokens/session: 380 -> 520
95th pct tokens/session: 1,200 -> 1,650
estimated GPU-hours/day (eu cluster): baseline 480 -> projected 620 (+29%)
models most impacted: rwd-gpt-large-16q, rwd-gpt-medium-8q
window: first 72 hours after rollout (user trial period)
```

tyler: 620 GPU-hrs/day projected. Current eu-west committed pool = 700 GPU-hrs/day but ~620 is already allocated across reserved customers; free headroom ~80 GPU-hrs/day. So we need a short-term plan for ~200 GPU-hrs/day extra headroom during the 72h window.

jo: Suggestion: staggered rollout + pre-warm limited hosts. Ramp schedule: 5% -> 20% (1h window) -> 60% (2h) -> 100% (monitor for 72h). If metrics OK, autoscaler can step down.

tyler: Agree. Operational plan idea:
- Pre-warm 6 additional A100-equivalent GPUs in eu-west (adds ~200 GPU-hrs/day headroom for burst concurrency)
- Lock canary to low-risk customers first (billing tags)
- Enable prefix/KV cache warmup scripts for affected models 1h before rollout

kunal: I sketched the quick cost estimate: additional infra cost ~ $11k-$14k for the 72h window (spot/backfill assumptions). Finance needs to sign off on temporary over-commit.

finance: Noted. Tagging requirement: infra please add charge tags `promo/pro-rate-mig` to any spun hosts. Will fast-track approval if we keep it <= $15k.

tyler: Will add the charge tag. Also proposing fallback routing: if latency > 800ms or GPU queue > 85% for 10m, route to lower-cost quantized model variant (rwd-gpt-medium-8q-quant) and throttle non-critical endpoints.

maria: That fallback sounds good. Product also wants soft rate-limits per user to reduce hot-spotting during spike — can we add a short per-user cooldown token?

tyler: Yes — we can add a transient quota: `user:burst_tokens=3` for promo period, enforced at edge. Implementation: update rate-limit rules in envoy layer + a lightweight redis counter.

infra-bot: autoscaler: temporary burst override applied for route `/v1/generate-pro` (+30% max) from 2025-11-03T09:00Z for 72h (audit id: AUT-20251103-74).

deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: eu-west-1 -> step function created: `canary/pro-rate-eu-20251103`

jo: Monitoring checklist for the 72h window:
- 1m and 5m latency for `/v1/generate` (p50/p95)
- GPU utilization per host and queue depth
- Token burn rate and per-customer spikes
- Fallback activations and successful routing counts
- Cost burn in billing dashboard (hourly)

tyler: I'll prepare the runbook and the pre-warm script. Plan to start pre-warm 2h before rollout.

maria: Thanks team. Kunal, can you confirm cost tag and add a quick note to the promo runbook? I'll sync with PM for a final go/no-go 24h before the rollout. :+1:

kunal: Yep — added `promo/pro-rate-mig` charge tag and put a placeholder note in the runbook.

maria: Great — closing the loop here. If anyone finds a blocker while prepping, ping me and I'll escalate. :wave:
